what_worked.description: Slow-motion 0.5x speed constraint prevents rapid garment blurring and fabric tear during Veo 3.1 turnaround
Continuous single camera dolly around model prevents jump cuts and keeps influencer identity rock-solid

what_failed.failure_mode: Model face morphing or warping during 180-degree rotation
what_failed.root_cause: Veo interpolating unseen rear face angles without strict facial anchor constraints
what_failed.drift_vector: Model's facial features changing upon turning back to front

what_to_adapt.rule_addition: Strictly inject: 'face morphing, warping, sudden cuts, glitch, jitter, erratic motion, rapid spin'
